# P1.02 — The Page: schema-first editor

Spec: `docs/tickets/30_P1.02__page-editor.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.02.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `dev` + bounded live verify) is
operator-gated and joins D-P1.01-1's `web` deploy leg; $0 inference either way.

## Summary

The beta's CodeMirror stopgap is replaced by the real Page: a **schema-first** Rhema-Markdown editor.
One explicit ProseMirror `Schema` in the new `@rhema/editor` package is consumed verbatim by the
Markdown parser, the canonical serializer, the tests, and the browser `EditorView` — no second source
of truth (Tiptap core would rebuild the schema from extension configs, so we use `prosemirror-*`
directly; MIT). Markdown stays the only persisted representation; PM JSON is never stored.

## What landed

**`@rhema/editor`** (new package, ~3.1k lines incl. tests):

- `schema.ts` — `pageSchema`: the Rhema block/inline vocabulary — headings, paragraphs, lists,
  blockquotes, code, hr; `footnote`/`footnote_def` (`[^n]`); inline + block `math`; `cite` (`[@key]`,
  multi-key `\[@k1; @k2]`), `figure`, front-matter.
- `md-to-pm.ts` / `pm-to-md.ts` — canonical `markdownToDoc` / `docToMarkdown` over the `@rhema/markdown`
  mdast. `roundtrip.test.ts` proves `md→PM→md` **byte-stable** and `PM→md→PM` **structurally equal**
  across golden fixtures: the three seeded projects + the full-profile fixture + a convert-output
  sample — **closes D-P0.09-2 (b)/(c)**.
- `blocks.ts` — block-id sidecar `{blockId → (ordinal, contentHash)}` with hash+ordinal+fuzzy
  re-derivation across an edited block; ids live only on `artifact_versions.block_id_map`, never in
  serialized markdown or the materialized mirror.
- `decorations.ts` — findings as sidecar decorations (never marks): anchors resolve through the
  findings-core ladder, ranges map into live PM positions, unresolved findings fall back to
  whole-piece; markdown byte-identical.
- `proposal.ts` — proposal card accept applies ONE transaction stamped `agent:<seat>:<run>` with
  `addToHistory:false` (human ⌘Z cannot undo it); reject is a no-op. Proposal content parses through
  the same `markdownToDoc` path.
- `provenance.ts` — block-level provenance sources (human/mobile-human/agent/pasted/chat/
  suggestion-applied/mixed — `mixed` added to `PROVENANCE_SOURCE_KINDS` + `provenanceSourceSchema`
  per REQ-POS-9), write-only agent span capture, human edit inside an agent span degrades the block
  to `mixed`; `authorshipClasses` renders the Authorship overlay as read-only decorations.
- `bibliography.ts` + `cite.ts` — BibTeX, CSL-JSON, and Zotero importers; cite resolution with
  visible dangling-key rendering.
- `meters.ts` — word count, reading time, venue-cap string for the status bar.
- `transport.ts` — the narrow `EditorTransport` seam (load doc / push update / lock state) +
  `httpTransport`; P1.03 swaps in the Yjs/collab transport without touching the Page.
- `plugins.ts` — `pagePlugins`, `createPageState`, `setDecorationInputs`.

**api + contracts** — `editor-routes` extended: the Page DTO now carries canonical markdown, `lock`,
projected findings, the provenance map, `block_id_map`, the project bibliography, the venue-cap meter
(computed api-side from `projects.venue` × the seeded protocol's `length_norms`/`venue_bar` — only the
rendered string crosses the wire, REQ-ARCH-33), word/read-time meters, and `proposals: []` (a producer
is P1.11's Assistant). `POST /projects/:id/bibliography` imports BibTeX/CSL-JSON/Zotero into a
content-addressed artifact row (`kind='bibliography'` @ `bibliography/csl.json` — `artifacts.kind` is
free text; the 63-row §8.2 `ARTIFACT_KINDS`/`artifactPolicy` set is untouched; the seat allowlist keeps
it out of agent mirrors). `GET /projects/:id/artifacts/:artifactId/page` serves the read-only artifact
Page (415 for non-markdown). The save path threads `provenanceForSave` spans and forks a frozen head
into `v(N+1) human_revision`; `?exact=1` pins a read to the named draft. api-client DTOs + methods;
`@rhema/contracts` gains `sha256.ts` (shared hex helper) and the `mixed` provenance kind.

**`@rhema/ui` + `apps/web`** — `PageEditor` SSR: chrome, PM/Markdown preview, findings rail, proposal
cards, authorship classes, and the three meters in the P1.01 status bar. Routes: `/p/:project` cuts
over to the working Page; `/p/:project/v/:n` + `/v/working` serve frozen/working revisions;
`/p/:project/a/:artifactId` serves the read-only artifact Page; `/p/:project/edit/:draftId` redirects
to the Page (Source mode stays dormant — REQ-SPEC-19's CodeMirror leg is 1.x). `client/page.ts` is the
third attribute-driven island (`build-client.mjs` → `public/page.js`): PM `EditorView` + plugins,
`createSyncMachine` (synced/syncing/queued-offline/locked), lock polling, autosave through
`httpTransport`, Authorship toggle registered in the Advanced View menu (`packages/ide`
`CONTROL_DISCLOSURE` + `viewMenuModel`).

**Semantics** — a reviewed/frozen draft is **editable**; the first edit forks `v(N+1)
human_revision` (the banner says so). Read-only attaches to an active-run lock (comments land as
Guidance) or a non-draft artifact — never to `state:"frozen"` alone.

## Test plan

- [x] `md→PM→md` byte-stable + `PM→md→PM` structural on the golden fixtures (`roundtrip.test.ts`)
- [x] Block ids sidecar-only; hash+ordinal+fuzzy re-derivation with an edited block (`blocks.test.ts`)
- [x] Finding renders as a decoration; markdown byte-identical (`decorations.test.ts`)
- [x] Proposal accept = one `agent:*` transaction, `⌘Z`-proof; reject no-op (`proposal.test.ts`)
- [x] Provenance per block; human edit inside an agent span → `mixed`; Authorship overlay leaves
      markdown unchanged (`provenance.test.ts`)
- [x] Footnote/math/`[@key]` round-trip; BibTeX + CSL-JSON + Zotero import; dangling key visible
      (`roundtrip.test.ts`, `bibliography.test.ts`)
- [x] Frozen draft editable → forks `v(N+1)`; active-run lock read-only; artifact Page read-only with
      banner (`apps/web/src/page.test.ts`, api `editor-routes` tests)
- [x] Status bar: word count, reading time, venue cap (`meters.test.ts` + SSR asserts)
- [ ] Stage B: `pulumi up dev`, headless assert of `/p/:project` + `/assets/page.js`, operator
      click-through — **D-P1.01-1**, operator-gated

## Notes for reviewers

- Canonical cite form is `\[@key]` — `mdast-util-to-markdown` defensively escapes `[` before a
  would-be reference label; this matches `normalizeMarkdown`'s output, so round-trips are byte-stable
  in both directions.
- The venue-cap meter renders a string like `+212 over WaPo` computed server-side; no protocol text
  reaches the client bundle (REQ-ARCH-33 — `check:protocol-markers` green).
- Merge policy: **OPERATOR** — do not merge; stacked on PR #55.
